issue.title: Segfault in test_conv_annual (test_period.py , when running nosetests)

repository.name: pandas
repository.description: Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and much more

issue.body:

issue.title: REGR: Buffer dtype mismatch, expected 'Python object' but got a string

labels.name: Regression
labels.description: Functionality that used to work in a prior pandas version

labels.name: Strings
labels.description: String extension data type and string data

repository.name: pandas
repository.description: Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and much more

issue.body:
- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest version of pandas.

- [ ] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the master branch of pandas.

---

**Note**: Please read [this guide](https://matthewrocklin.com/blog/work/2018/02/28/minimal-bug-reports) detailing how to provide the necessary information for us to reproduce your bug.

#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example

```python
# Your code here
>>> import pandas as pd
>>> df = pd.DataFrame(['o',"o'doul's",'oad','oaf','oafish'])
>>> df = df.astype('|S')
>>> df

3       b'oaf'
4    b'oafish'
>>> import numpy as np
>>> df.replace({None:np.nan})


```

#### Problem description

This was working in 1.1.5
